title: Trigger tree root (map/triggers/triggers.json)
description: The trigger tree's versions, root item and script mode (docs/trigger-folders-spec.md, section 2), read and written by crates/w3proj/src/trigger_layout.rs. Unknown keys are errors there, so they are refused here too.

format.description: w3proj.triggers/1; a later 1.x reads the same, a newer major version is refused

reforged.description: war3map.wtg has the Reforged marker (root item, ids, folds, nesting, comments, script items, variable nodes)

unknown.description: war3map.wtg's number after the variables count; 2 when missing

wctVersion.description: war3map.wct's version; 1 and later have a custom script header

wctReforged.description: only where war3map.wct's Reforged marker differs from `reforged`

root.description: the map item at the top of a Reforged tree; missing in a classic one

script.description: generated: war3map.j/.lua is made from the map; kept: it is a tracked source. kept when missing

counts.description: imported maps only: war3map.wtg's id counters per item type, with their deleted ids, as stored

variableOrder.description: imported maps only: the variable table's order, where it differs from the tree's

text.description: a name or value war3map.wtg stores: no zero character
